summary: Runs a fixed 4-iteration loop calling sub_4F18C0 on the this object with the loop index, the second argument a2 and a constant 0. After the loop, if the flag argument a3 is non-zero, invokes TireBrushModelForceSolver on the this object with 0. Called from five AI/vehicle-physics sites including AIMainUpdate, AISteeringRacingLineCorrection, PitStopOperationTimer and SuspensionAndWheelPhysics.

local_names.a2: call-through argument passed unchanged to sub_4F18C0
local_names.a3: conditional flag selecting the TireBrushModelForceSolver call

operations.description: Loop i from 0 to 3 inclusive, calling sub_4F18C0 with (this, i, a2, 0).
If a3 is non-zero, call TireBrushModelForceSolver with (this, 0).

unresolved: Purpose of the 4-iteration sub_4F18C0 loop (per-wheel or per-subsystem setup) is not established by this packet's evidence.
Meaning of the a2 argument and of the constant 0 passed to sub_4F18C0 is unknown.
Meaning of the a3 flag and why TireBrushModelForceSolver is invoked only when it is set is unknown.
Owner object is unconfirmed; evidence shows only a thiscalls convention and no owning class.
